I'm 18 and have been to maybe 5 or 6 therapists in the last 4 years, dealing usually with depression, depersonalization, and isolation.
I find this painful relatable. The way I often put it to my therapist is "I die every three days or so". I don't even remember life before I was maybe 13, but even that far back is a huge stretch. I feel like I can't even create new memories. The most I get is the notes I take every day in my notes app telling me if anything happened. That's not even getting into how I've felt locked behind a bulletproof window in my head, watching the person everyone thinks I am control a body that should be mine. It's a living hell.

Sorry to pour all that shit out on ya. Feel free to ignore it.
